paper_id: Miao et al. - 2011 - Agnostic diagnosis Discovering silent failures in wireless sensor networks
title: Agnostic Diagnosis: Discovering Silent Failures in Wireless Sensor Networks
motivation: GreenOrbs部署八个月后发现大量silent failures，现有supervised方法无法发现未知类型的故障
problem_framing: 把unknown failures检测重新定义为correlation pattern violation问题，通过跨节点和时序的相关性异常来发现
key_insight: 单个metric值正常不代表节点正常——metric间的correlation patterns才是关键，violation即故障信号
method_signature: Correlation Graph + Temporal CUSUM + Spatial PCA聚类两阶段交叉验证
evaluation_criteria: case studies + 30节点人工对比验证spatial detection准确率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: K-Means需要预先给定K值；window长度存在检测延迟与误报率的trade-off
evidence_for_taste: individual metric is insufficient to uncover failures
exploiting correlations of metrics uncovers significantly more failures
the diagnostic capacity is restricted by our incomplete knowledge
individual examination of metrics may overlook silent failures
thinking_moves: 从单个metric异常判断转向metric间correlation异常判断
用Pearson系数将相关性量化为可追踪的时序信号
先时序检测后空间聚类，双重过滤减少误报
PCA降维解决高维相关性矩阵的聚类难题
extraction_notes: venue信息在文中未明确标注，根据内容风格推断为IEEE INFOCOM; role根据作者列表和abstract署名判断
